# GetATSReady — llms.txt
# Free ATS resume checker — https://www.getatsready.com
# Updated: October 2026

## What is GetATSReady?

GetATSReady (getatsready.com) is a free, browser-based resume checker that estimates keyword overlap, section headers, metrics in bullets, and layout risk against a job description you paste. The free scan parses PDF/DOCX locally in the browser. It is not a live connection to Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, or other vendor ATS products, and it does not guarantee interviews or that a human will read your application.

## What problem does it solve?

Many employers filter applications with ATS software. GetATSReady helps you see parsing and keyword gaps before you apply: match estimate, missing terms from the pasted job description, and formatting risks such as multi-column or table-heavy layouts.

## Key features

- Local free scan (PDF and DOCX) — resume file is not uploaded for that scan
- Keyword overlap vs a pasted job description
- Structure / section-header checks, metrics hints, and layout-risk signals
- Free resume maker that downloads a text-based PDF via jsPDF
- Role and vendor guidance pages (informational; not vendor emulators)
- Optional paid human review (separate intake; file upload only on that form)
- Analytics (Google Analytics) and ads (AdSense) may load; cookie storage defaults to denied until Accept
- Sentry error reporting (session replay rates are 0)

## Who uses it?

- Job seekers checking a resume against a specific posting
- Graduates and career changers iterating on keywords and layout
- Anyone who wants a local parse check before applying

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is the free scan really free?
A: Yes. Unlimited local scans, no account. Ads help fund the site. Optional paid human review is separate.

Q: Does my resume leave the device on a free scan?
A: The free scan parses in the browser and does not upload the resume file. The page still loads analytics, ads, Sentry, font/CDN scripts, and may call geo IP helpers for checkout currency. An optional email box can send your address and score (not the file). A paid intake form is how a file gets sent.

Q: How does the score work?
A: With a job description: roughly keyword overlap 40%, structure 20%, impact/metrics 20%, format/layout risk 20%, with template issues able to discount keyword credit. Without a JD, format/structure/impact only. It is a local estimate, not a vendor ATS score.

Q: Do you emulate Workday / Taleo / Greenhouse scoring?
A: No. Pages may discuss those products for context. The tool does not mirror their proprietary ranking.

Q: Are there fake usage stats?
A: Public counters (when shown) come from Firebase increments after completed local scans or maker downloads. Do not invent metrics beyond what the counters report.
